rows.text: The page states that 'La cérémonie d'investiture du Président de la République a eu lieu au palais de l'Elysée mercredi 16 mai à 11 heures', that the President of the Council proclaimed the final results of the election of 22 April and 6 May 2007, that the Grand Chancellor of the Legion of Honour presented the collar and that the President then gave an address.
